facts.title: A loud shortcut
facts.description: The axe clears soft wood quickly, but its loud noise travels farther than working by hand.

facts.title: Held by the ground
facts.description: A Shambler that steps into a pit waits there until the pit expires. The pit causes no damage.

facts.title: Following the sound
facts.description: The Listener follows a heard noise toward its source. Its announced step stays fixed; a new sound can change the next plan.
